summary.summary:
Migrated the SQLAlchemy store from 1.4 to 2.0 APIs.

Code changes:
- src/coilmq/store/sa/__init__.py: MetaData(bind=engine) replaced with MetaData(). List-form select([...]) calls replaced with positional select(...) in dequeue, has_frames, size and destinations. Row lookups by Column in dequeue changed from first[col] to first._mapping[col].
- src/coilmq/store/sa/model.py: create_all() and drop_all() now receive meta.engine explicitly (no bound metadata).

Dependency pins:
- pyproject.toml: optional 'sqlalchemy' extra and the 'tests' group changed from sqlalchemy<2 to sqlalchemy>=2.0. No companion packages in this repo depend on SQLAlchemy.

Results: the latest full run passed with 201 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 3 skipped (the same skips as before the migration).

Caveats:
- tests/protocol/test_1_1.py::TestSTOMP11::test_no_heartbeat_from_client is timing-sensitive (about 3 ms of slack against a 200 ms heartbeat check, per the test's own FIXME). It has failed on several full runs and passed on others. It is not caused by the SQLAlchemy changes; I did not edit the test or the heartbeat logic. It is now reachable because the memory functional tests run instead of erroring at setup. It should be fixed separately by widening the margin or making the timing deterministic.
- uv.lock was not regenerated. It still contains sqlalchemy<2 specifiers and the locked 1.4.x entry. Run `uv lock` so the lockfile matches the new pin; the verify-lockfile CI check will fail until then.
